name: Hubert Lipton
original_name: ヒューバート・リプトン
source:
Hubert Lipton is the former Lieutenant General of the Helman Second Army, the son of [url=/c56830]Thoma Lipton[/url], one of the strongest humans to have ever lived, and the best friend and trusted right hand of Patton Misnarge.

[From [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/Hubert_Lipton]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
